payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute cycles of indices mod N under D-step mapping; for each cycle, find max consecutive ones; if entire cycle is ones then -1 else max streak steps.
payload.rationale: Code implicitly traverses each cycle of the functional graph (i -> i+D mod N) to count one-streaks, resembling DFS/BFS on a graph. Other subtypes (branch/bound, backtracking, enumeration) are not used.
